svg.title: Macroscope: a code review the agent runs, checks and fixes
svg.desc: The model calls run_macroscope_review, which runs macroscope codereview --raw in the run's workspace. The CLI uploads the branch diff to Macroscope's service and streams findings back, and the tool returns them as a MacroscopeReview with a review id, a status and a list of MacroscopeIssue findings. The agent then checks each finding and fixes the real ones with its own file and shell tools. Setup problems, such as a missing or signed-out CLI, raise UserError and stop the run.
